note: Rewritten from Roonwal & Chhotani (1997), entry 95; the original is in English. The original describes only the soldier and worker, the alate being recorded as unknown. The diagnostic characters follow the soldier key in that work (p. 572). The synonymy list, literature citations, figure numbers, type-specimen records and distribution records have been removed.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head length to mandible base 1.92–2.23 mm, width 1.19–1.34 mm; mandibles relatively short for the head (mandible length/head length ratio 0.55–0.59); mandibular teeth indistinct; head paler and narrower (width/head length ratio 0.60–0.62). In ahmadi the mandibles are relatively longer (ratio about 0.65), the mandibular teeth distinct, and the head darker and wider (0.64–0.65). Alate unknown.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule brownish yellow, paler posteriorly; antennae, labrum and pronotum pale brown; mandibles nearly black, dark brown at the base; abdomen and legs white-yellow. Hairs on the head and pronotum fairly numerous, body hairs dense. Body length 5.8–6.35 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, longer than wide (length to mandible base 1.92–2.23 mm, width 1.19–1.34 mm); sides nearly straight, slightly narrowed anteriorly; frons sloping forwards; Y suture indistinct. Fontanelle minute, slightly raised, situated a little behind the intersection of the occipital sutures. Eyes white, indistinct, length 0.10–0.14 mm. Ocelli indistinct. Antennae 12–13-segmented; segment 2 small, segment 3 large and sclerotized, more than twice as long as segment 2, segment 4 smaller than segment 3. Boundary between postclypeus and frons indistinct, hairy; anteclypeus hairless, a translucent narrow band. Labrum slightly wider than long, anterior margin rounded (length 0.30–0.34 mm, width 0.34–0.38 mm). Mandibles sabre-shaped, slightly incurved apically, shorter than 2/3 of the head length (length 1.14–1.26 mm, mandible length/head length ratio 0.55–0.59); without distinct mandibular teeth, the base of the left mandible with several weak serrations. Postmentum club-shaped, with a long waist (length 1.34–1.61 mm, maximum width 0.46–0.57 mm, minimum width 0.17–0.23 mm; contraction index 0.37–0.43). Pronotum flat, narrower than the head, sub-trapezoidal (length 0.61–0.76 mm, width 1.0–1.13 mm); anterior margin convex with a deep median concavity; anterolateral corners narrow; sides strongly narrowed posteriorly; posterior margin slightly notched in the middle. Apical tibial spur formula 3:2:2; tarsi 3-segmented. Abdomen elongate, hairy; cerci 2-segmented; abdominal spines absent.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule straw-yellow; body, antennae and legs white. Body length 3.9–5.5 mm. Head capsule subcircular (length to mandible base 0.94–1.14 mm, width 1.0–1.23 mm); Y suture present. Eyes small, subcircular. Antennae 14-segmented. Labrum wider than long, anterior margin rounded. Postclypeus slightly inflated, with a median longitudinal groove. Mandibles of the typical Stylotermes type. Pronotum flat, width slightly less than twice the length (length 0.50–0.60 mm, width 0.80–1.00 mm); anterior margin deeply concave in the middle. Legs and abdomen as in the soldier.
